'''Sports'''
*[[2026 FIFA World Cup]]
**[[2026 FIFA World Cup controversies]]
***[[2026 Trump–FIFA red card controversy]]
****In [[association football]], [[FIFA]] declares [[United States men's national soccer team|American]] [[Forward (association football)|forward]] [[Folarin Balogun]] eligible to face [[Belgium national football team|Belgium]] following an intervention by [[U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]]. FIFA suspends his ban under Article 27 of the [[FIFA Disciplinary Code]], placing it on a one-year probationary period while allowing the [[Fouls and misconduct (association football)|red card]] itself to stand. It became the first time since the introduction of FIFA's automatic suspension system that a [[FIFA World Cup|World Cup]] red card suspension is overturned rather than served. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cewqq5q8v41o (BBC News)] [https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7423410/2026/07/05/usmnt-folarin-balogun-red-card-available/ (''The New York Times'')]
**[[Norway at the FIFA World Cup]], [[Brazil at the FIFA World Cup]]
***[[Norway national football team|Norway]] advances to the [[2026 FIFA World Cup#Quarterfinals|quarterfinals]] of a [[FIFA World Cup]] for the first time after defeating [[Brazil national football team|Brazil]] 2–1 in the [[2026 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#Round of 16|round of 16]]. Brazil's loss also marks the team's earliest elimination from the tournament since [[1990 FIFA World Cup|1990]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/sports/20260705-haaland-knocks-brazil-out-of-world-cup-as-norway-reach-quarters (AFP via RFI)]
